description:
Start a new run of a Batch job whose latest run ended (completed, stopped or failed). By default it reruns only the tasks that failed or never started (status ["failed", "pending"]), and carries the others' results over: the recovery after a run that failed on credits or was cancelled. Pass status to pick other task statuses, or full:true to scrape every task again. Rerun tasks are billed like new ones.

A rerun of only some tasks works up to 10 days after the run started (BATCH_RERUN_WINDOW_EXPIRED after that; full:true still works). BATCH_NO_MATCHING_TASKS: no task has those statuses. BATCH_RUN_NOT_FINISHED: the latest run is still in flight. Sends an Idempotency-Key, so a retry never starts two runs. Returns the new run at once (it writes its tasks first, ingesting:true); call batch_wait.

full.description: Rerun every task, not only some (default false)

idempotency_key.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key header, up to 128 characters; generated per call when unset. Reusing a key with the identical request within 24 hours returns the original response instead of doing it again; with a different request it is BATCH_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

job_id.description: Batch job id returned by batch_create or batch_list

status.description: Task statuses to rerun (default ["failed", "pending"]). Ignored with full:true.

name: batch_rerun
